about_the_game:
Join our Discord!

After touching a mysterious sphere artifact, you're transported to the dimension where Balloo`s Mall vanished. Once you entered the mall, it's now a decaying labyrinth haunted by warped, immortal beings. Uncover the artifact that keeps them alive—and find out if eternal life is a cure, or a curse.

When the Dnipro Research Company discovers sphere-shaped artifacts buried deep in Eastern European caves, contact with them reveals a terrifying secret: they teleport anyone who touches them to other dimensions. One such artifact caused the sudden disappearance of Balloo`s Mall, a real-world shopping center that simply vanished—leaving behind only an empty place.

You are sent in dimension which keeps Balloo`s Mall within. You awaken in a liminal, decaying version of the mall, now suspended in another reality. The people who were once trapped there have changed—assimilated into monstrous, unkillable forms by a mysterious force that keeps them alive. Somewhere inside, that force still exists… and your mission is to retrieve it.

Dnipro Research believes it holds the key to immortality. But as you descend deeper into the nightmare, you may begin to question whether immortality is salvation—or something much worse.

CONTROLS

W,A,S,D - Move

F - Off/On flashlight

Escape/P - Pause

  • Liminal Spaces.

  • Atmosphere.

  • Cool lore.

  • Something new.

  • Morality.
